title: Super-Slow Videos
content: Did you ever wonder what happens in slow motion when a martial arts expert whacks his hand against a stack of bricks? The fingers flex alarmingly.The video also shows what happens when an egg drops onto a mousetrap, and many other examples of things being destroyed slowly.What does lightning look like when it’s slowed  way, way down? It turns out that there are discharges of many different frequencies. Multiple strikes travel over established channels.Via Best of YouTube.
